articles.summary: XPEL, Inc. (Nasdaq: XPEL), a leading provider of protective films and coatings, and acclaimed car customizer and TV personality, Will Castro, today announced that Season 2 of ‘ Unique Academy USA’ will debut August 18th on the ROKU platform. The new season expands the program's reach, enrolling 15 new students – between the ages of 13 and 22 – in hands-on training designed to prepare the students for careers in the automotive technician and aftermarket industry. XPEL and acclaimed car customizer and TV personality, Will Castro, announced that Season 2 of ‘Unique Academy USA’ will debut on August 18th on ROKU. The program introduces inner-city youth to professional skills in automotive window film installation, paint protection film application and ceramic coating, at no cost to students. articles.summary: XPEL, Inc. (Nasdaq: XPEL) (the "Company"), a global provider of protective films and coatings, announced consolidated results 1 for the second quarter and six months ended June 30, 2026. Second Quarter 2026 Overview: Revenue increased 14.7% to $143.1 million in the second quarter of 2026 compared to $124.7 million in the second quarter of 2025. Gross margin of 44.1% in the second quarter of 2026 compared to 42.9% in the second quarter last year. Net income attributable to stockholders of the company increased 10.7% to $18.0 million, or $0.65 per basic and diluted share, versus net income attributable to stockholders of the Company of $16.3 million, or $0.59 per basic and diluted share in the second quarter of 2025. Adjusted net income attributable to stockholders increased 15.6% to $18.8 million. Adjusted earnings per share was $0.68 per basic and diluted share.
